title: HeroBanner
description: Fiori hero banner: overline, heading, actions and one or two content columns on the Horizon hero background (ui5-hero-banner).

usage.summary: Introduce a product home page with a greeting, context and task shortcuts.
useWhen: Welcome users to a product home page and surface the context and tasks they need first.
Place the hero below the shell bar, let it scroll away, and aim for a height of 5.75–24rem (92–384px).
Supply the date or greeting through overlineText and headerText, and place supporting content and secondary buttons in the content and actions areas.

avoidWhen.when: Preview one focused business topic with a route to its underlying content.
Keep filters and page actions in a header that collapses while users work with business data.
